questions: Should the function handle tuples of varying lengths? If so, how are missing positions treated for mean calculation (e.g., fill with np.nan, skip entirely)?
Are numeric values defined as only int and float, or should complex numbers, Decimal, or numpy numeric types also be considered numeric?
Should the function overwrite the file if it already exists, or should it append to it?
Is the output file expected to have a trailing newline after the last line?
Should the mean be computed as a floating-point number even for integer inputs, or should it preserve integer division if applicable?
How should the function handle the case where all numeric values at a position are NaN? Should it output NaN or something else?
Are there any constraints on the string length or content in the first tuple position that could affect file writing?
Should the function raise an error if the file path is invalid or unwritable, or should it handle such errors silently?
